name: How do I protect my home during a luxury remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I protect the rest of my house during a high-end remodel?
mainEntity.text: How can I protect the rest of my house during a high-end remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Site protection is critical in luxury remodeling because premium finishes can be damaged easily by dust, traffic, and material movement. The contractor should define protected zones, install barriers, cover floors, and manage where trades enter and exit. HVAC systems may need isolation or filtration so dust does not spread throughout the home. Furniture, artwork, and valuables should be relocated or stored safely before work begins. Daily cleanup matters too, because the worksite should remain orderly and safe as the project progresses. Homeowners should ask the contractor how protection is handled at each phase, especially in occupied homes or projects with adjacent finished spaces. A well-run job keeps the rest of the home functional and reduces the chance of cosmetic damage that can become expensive to repair. Good protection is a sign of professional project management, not an optional extra.
acceptedAnswer.description: Protect the home with dust barriers, floor protection, controlled access, sealed HVAC zones, and clear work paths for trades. High-end remodels also benefit from furniture storage, daily cleanup, and protection of adjacent rooms and finishes. Good site protection reduces damage, dust migration, and cleanup costs.
